fields.name: add_remote_addr
fields.description: Inject a remote address field into the record, using the X-Forwarded-For header or the connection address as the value.

fields.name: buffer_chunk_size
fields.description: Set the chunk size for incoming JSON messages. These chunks are then stored and managed in the space available by buffer_max_size. Compatibility alias for http_server.buffer_chunk_size.

fields.name: buffer_max_size
fields.description: Set the maximum buffer size to receive a JSON message. Compatibility alias for http_server.buffer_max_size.

fields.name: http2
fields.description: Enable HTTP/2 support. Compatibility alias for http_server.http2.

fields.name: http_server.workers
fields.description: Number of HTTP listener worker threads.

fields.name: port
fields.description: The port for Fluent Bit to listen on.

fields.name: remote_addr_key
fields.description: Record key name used to store the remote address when add_remote_addr is enabled.

fields.name: splunk_token
fields.description: Specify a Splunk token for HTTP HEC authentication. If multiple tokens are specified (with commas and no spaces), usage will be divided across each of the tokens.

fields.name: splunk_token_key
fields.description: Set a record key for storing the Splunk token for HTTP HEC. Use only when store_token_in_metadata is false.

fields.name: store_token_in_metadata
fields.description: Store Splunk HEC tokens in the Fluent Bit metadata. If set to false, they will be stored as key-value pairs in the record data.

fields.name: success_header
fields.description: Add an HTTP header key/value pair on success. Multiple headers can be set.

fields.name: tag_key
fields.description: Specify the key name to overwrite a tag. If set, the tag will be overwritten by a value of the key.

fields.name: threaded
fields.description: Indicates whether to run this input in its own thread.

fields.name: tag
fields.description: Tag assigned to records emitted by this input plugin.
